fact: On 9 May 2026 the national news agency reported that the National Communication Observatory suspended nine foreign media outlets (France 24, RFI, AFP, TV5Monde, TF1 Info, Jeune Afrique, Mediapart, France Afrique Média, LSI Africa) across the national territory, including their websites and mobile applications, over content it said threatened public order.
title: Communication : Neuf médias français suspendus au Niger
